title: Governors Ball 2026: Here’s How to Score Festival  Tickets Before They Sell Out
summary: The jam-packed music festival features headliners like Lorde and A$AP Rocky and is scheduled to take place from June 5-7 at Flushing Meadows Corona Park in New York.
contentText:

Governors Ball has become an institution of music culture in New York since its conception back in 2011 back on Governors Island, its namesake.

This year’s multi-day festival is going to be a smash-hit, with a head-turning lineup that you won’t want to miss out on. Gov. Ball is set to take place from Jan. 5 through the 7th at Flushing Meadows Corona Park in New York, a spacious grassy venue with tons of room, giving festival goers tons of space to dance and jam out to their favorite artists.

Speaking of artists, this year’s lineup is a doozy, with Billboard chart-topping names like A$AP Rocky , Lorde , BLACKPINK’s Jennie along with other popular acts that Katseye, Wet Leg, Pierce The Veil Tickets, Blood Orange, Japanese Breakfast, Geese, 2Hollis, The Dare and so much more. Though Lorde played Gov Ball in 2017, this year marks her first time as a headliner, while Harlem native Rocky previously top-lined the event in 2021. In fact, there are plenty of New Yorkers on the lineup including Geese, The Dare, Del Water Gap, Arcy Drive and Lexa Gates, The Backfires and Chanpan.

If you’re looking to secure your tickets to the festival, look no further than this article. We’ve compiled a list of ticketing sites where you can snag tickets for one or all three of the festival days before they sell out. Keep reading to find out more.

Where to Get Tickets to Governors Ball 2026

A three-day general admission ticket to the festival via Ticketmaster will run you $339, while a three day GA+ pass currently goes for $575.00. Pricing for a single day depends on which wristband/experience you purchase. For instance, a Saturday ticket for GA+ will cost $289.00, while a Saturday GA ticket will run you $159.00. That goes for each tier up to VIP.

Ticketmaster is always great choice, but fans can find some of the best ticket deals through third-party resale platforms like StubHub , Seat Geek , VividSeats and GameTime . You’ll have to do your own digging on each site to find the best deals and seats for you. Click through below to peruse tickets for Gov. Ball from the mentioned sites. We’re even hooking you up with discount codes on us to give you the opportunity to save some cash along the way.

BEST PRICES

StubHub

find tickets here

Pricing we’ve seen doing a quick search for high-volume days has been as low as $257. StubHub’s fan initiative protects fans purchases by ensuring valid tickets or your money back. Plus, if your event is canceled and not rescheduled, you will receive a credit worth 120% of the amount you paid for the impacted event, or the option of a cash refund.

PROMO CODES

SeatGeek

With our help, you can grab tickets to the music festival with ease at Seat Geek . Right now, you can use promo code BILLBOARD10 at checkout to receive $10 off at checkout. We’ve seen tickets at some venues for as low as $69. The ticketing service features a Buyer Guarantee that ensures smooth ticket purchases every time. The site also offers you venue options based on your location, giving you the closest venue to you.

EARN REWARDS

Vividseats

You can grab your desired tier through Vivid Seats now for as low as $202 for GA . The ticketing service offers a 100% Buyer Guarantee that vows your transaction will be secure, that your tickets will be delivered before your event and that those tickets will be valid and authentic. Right now, you can use promo code BB30 to snag $30 off of your purchase. Our favorite feature of the site is that it shows you the lowest ticket pricing for each venue on the landing page without having to click into the venue so you can compare in one place.

SEATING OPTIONS

Gametime

Gametime features a slew of prices for different tiers, the most versatile we’ve seen. Some venues have tickets starting at $225 , a steal given how in high-demand some of the festival days are. Gametime guarantees the lowest prices, event cancellation protection, job loss assurance and on-time ticket delivery for a smooth ticket buying experience every time, no matter the occasion.

STANDARD TICKETING OPTIONS

Ticketmaster

The ticketing service offers a Fan Guarantee, which allows for cancellations, refunds or exchanges within 24 hours of booking, subject to certain exclusions. The site also recently announced that they’re barring fans and brokers from operating multiple accounts on its platform.

They also plan to shut down its long-criticized TradeDesk ticket uploading application and start requiring ticket brokers to hand over their Social Security numbers in order to sell tickets on Ticketmaster’s resale platform, further making sure your tickets are secure.
